say: I've been on this bench since six with half a heater. Ask me how I am. Actually don't.
If one more thing goes wrong this week I'm switching her to swimming. I won't. But I'll say it.
@how_are_things

options.text: I'm sorry. What would make it better?
It's an old building. Bear with us.
Rinks are hard. Take it or leave it.

say: She's working the Lutz today. Watch. No, don't watch, she'll know you're watching.
{event}. I can't look. Tell me if she lands it.
That's her program music. I've heard it four hundred times. It still gets me.

options.text: She looks great out there.
I'll let you watch.

say: Morning. Is it morning? It's dark. We left the house at 5:10.
Six am ice. I don't even drink coffee. I hold it for warmth.

options.text: Good to see you anyway.

say: {owner}, sit. There's room on the bench. There's always room at this hour.
Oh good, you're here. Can you tell me honestly if that was a two-foot landing?

options.text: Good to see you too, {known_as}.

say: @how_are_things
Sorry, I'm watching her edges. What do you need?
Hi. I'm counting rotations. Go ahead, I can do both.

options.text: How's her skating coming along?
What brings you to the rink?
What do you make of the rink?
Any news from the bench?
What would make this place better for you?
Take care.

say: She has a test coming. Hélène says she's ready. Hélène said 'acceptable', which means ready.
She landed her axel on Tuesday and called her grandmother from the penalty box.
Up and down. Mostly down, then up. That's the sport.

options.text: She's lucky to have you on the bench.
Tell me a bit about yourself.
Glad you come.
Good to know you, {known_as}.

say: The heaters over the bench? Half of them work. We sit under the working half like birds on a wire.
We drive past two newer rinks to get here. It's the coaching. It's not the bench.
@ice

options.text: The ice has been better lately, hasn't it?
Noticed the work on the building?
Fair enough. We're working on it.

say: The morning ice has been lovely. Flat. You can hear the blades sing.
No ruts on the takeoff. She landed four in a row. I wrote it down.

options.text: Glad it shows.

say: The lobby's warmer. I sat inside for a minute. I felt like a person.
The washrooms have soap now. I noticed. Everybody noticed.

options.text: That's the idea.

say: Paolo Marchetti films every practice from three angles. He's got a drone on order. Pray for us.
Hélène ironed the club banner again. Nobody asked her. Nobody ever asks her.

options.text: Ha. Good to know.

say: Fix the heaters over the bench. All of them. We'll bring our own coffee, I promise.
Heat. Just heat. Six am on a cold bench is a test I didn't sign up for.

options.text: I'll see what I can do.
Can't promise anything, but noted.
You're not the first to say it. It's on the list.

say: I have to go zip a dress. Don't ask.
Off you go. I have to film the run-through. Somebody has to, besides Paolo.
